data.raw_text:
[10PM] #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Good movement from CMS bridge to Ijora Olopa, via Offin Canal market stretch.
Slow movement from CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal due to market activities and high pedestrian influx. However, movement is good after Offin Canal towards Eko Bridge by NEPA intersection.
Steady movement along Broad Street stretch to Apongbon underneath the bridge, connecting Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo.
Good movement on Eko Bridge by NEPA intersection inward Apongbon, although there's a report of slow movement on Eko Bridge inward Apongbon due to a breakdown of a truck occupying a lane.
Smooth traffic descending Eko Bridge inward CMS, Elegbeta Mini Stadium, and Ebute-Ero Market.
Good movement from Ebute-Ero Market to Leventist through UBA Roundabout, connecting inner and outer Marina.

#FollowLASTMA
